case.summary: Transaction 3640919 ($881.55) on card C09241-K2 was alerted due to a legacy real-time risk score of 0.71. Investigation confirmed the transaction was conducted in person in billing region 494, an established home market accounting for 491 prior transactions and active recent spending. The cardholder has no record of confirmed fraud, no card testing patterns were observed, and the card is not linked to any fraud ring or suspicious devices. Precedent cases with similar model score alerts on comparable purchase amounts were verified as legitimate cardholder purchases. The alert is deemed a false alarm on legitimate cardholder activity, and the case is closed with no fraud.
